# Darwinbox | Product Overview

Darwinbox is a cloud HCM for over 1,000 people, covering core HR, talent, pay, staff experience and AI. The core of the product is to create a unified workspace around staff, recruitment, pay/leave time or talent management, reducing fragmentation tools and manual maintenance.
